name: A creature card in a graveyard with a keyword gives that keyword
notes: Cairn Wanderer: "As long as a creature card with flying is in a graveyard, this creature has flying. The same is true for …"; Bleeding Effect's trigger: "… gain flying until end of turn if a creature card in your graveyard has flying. The same is true for …". The opponent's graveyard has Serra Angel (flying, vigilance), yours Craw Wurm and Giant Spider (reach): Cairn Wanderer has flying, vigilance and reach, not trample; Bleeding Effect gives your creatures reach only (Serra Angel is not in your graveyard).

scryfallData.name: Cairn Wanderer
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
As long as a creature card with flying is in a graveyard, this creature has flying. The same is true for fear, first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, landwalk, lifelink, protection, reach, trample, shroud, and vigilance.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Bleeding Effect
scryfallData.oracle_text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, creatures you control gain flying until end of turn if a creature card in your graveyard has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"What is a man but the sum of his memories? We are the stories we live! The tales we tell ourselves!"
—Clay Kaczmarek
